subject: BJ's Flammable Storage License Petition
overview: The City Council denied BJ's Wholesale Club's petition for a flammable storage license following an extensive public hearing. The Council also received an update on Eversource transmission line work along Winthrop Street and passed resolutions regarding 5G rollout safeguards, snow plowing investigations, and MBTA station naming.

items.title: Public Hearing on BJ's Wholesale Club Flammable Storage License
items.summary: The Council denied a petition from BJ's Wholesale Club for a flammable storage license for 64,000 gallons of gas following opposition from residents regarding neighborhood, traffic, and environmental impacts.

items.title: Update on Eversource Underground Transmission Project
items.summary: Eversource project management and the City Engineer presented an update on Winthrop Street transmission line construction, and the Council passed a motion requesting police detail planning to complete the project by the end of 2022.

items.title: Resolution Commemorating State Senator Charles E. Shannon Jr.
items.summary: The Council held a moment of silence and dedicated the meeting to the memory of late State Senator Charles E. Shannon Jr. on the 16th anniversary of his passing.

items.title: Resolution Regarding Snow Plowing Investigation
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution requesting an executive session with the city administration to discuss an ongoing investigation into municipal snow plowing operations.

items.title: Resolution on Italian American Heritage District Feasibility
items.summary: The Council requested that the Historic District Commission examine the feasibility of an Italian American heritage district in South Medford and provide a timeline for citywide historic district planning.

items.title: Resolution Requesting MBTA Station Renaming
items.summary: The Council renewed its request to the MBTA General Manager to name the upcoming Green Line Extension station 'Ball Square South Medford'.

items.title: Resolution on Verizon 5G Small Cell Rollout and Safeguards
items.summary: Following resident concerns, the Council passed motions requesting an emergency meeting with the administration on 5G policy, health impact input from the Board of Health Director, and a legal opinion on pole extensions.

items.title: Condolences on the Passing of Joe Bruno
items.summary: The Council expressed condolences and held a moment of silence for community leader Joe Bruno following his recent passing.

items.title: Committee Report on Housing Production Plan
items.summary: The Council adopted the Committee of the Whole report regarding the city's Housing Production Plan.

items.title: Public Participation on SNAP Awareness Week
items.summary: Resident Diane Sullivan informed the Council and public about SNAP Awareness Week and food assistance resources available through Project Bread.
